nodes.description: Owner address of the Ownable/Pausable/BMW contracts; grants privileged access to onlyOwner functions.
Pending owner address used in the two-step ownership transfer flow.
Pause flag controlling whenNotPaused/whenPaused modifiers.
ERC20 token name, set to "BMW" in constructor.
ERC20 token symbol, set to "BMW" in constructor.
Initial supply constant used to derive totalSupply_.
Total token supply, mutated by burn and mint.
Mapping of holder balances; written by transfer, transferFrom, lock, unlock, distribute, burn, mint, releaseTimeLock.
Mapping of lock status per holder, toggled by lock, unlock, releaseTimeLock.
Mapping of frozen accounts checked by the notFrozen modifier.
Allowance mapping written by approve, increaseAllowance, decreaseAllowance and consumed by transferFrom.
Mapping address => LockupInfo[] holding vesting rounds; mutated by lock, unlock, releaseTimeLock, autoUnlock.
SafeMath multiplication with assert-based overflow check.
SafeMath division.
SafeMath subtraction with assert(b <= a) underflow check.
SafeMath addition with assert-based overflow check.
Sets owner = msg.sender and newOwner = address(0).
onlyOwner; sets newOwner for two-step ownership transfer.
onlyNewOwner; promotes newOwner to owner and clears newOwner.
onlyOwner whenNotPaused; sets paused = true.
onlyOwner whenPaused; sets paused = false.
Initializes name, symbol, initialSupply, totalSupply_ and assigns the whole supply to owner.
Payable fallback that unconditionally reverts.
View returning totalSupply_.
ERC20 transfer; whenNotPaused notFrozen(msg.sender); may call autoUnlock.
View returning balance plus locked balance computed from lockupInfo.
ERC20 transferFrom; whenNotPaused notFrozen(_from); may call autoUnlock.
whenNotPaused; writes allowed[msg.sender][_spender].
Approves a contract spender and invokes receiveApproval on it, enabling reentrancy.
Adds addedValue to the caller's allowance for spender.
Subtracts subtractedValue from the caller's allowance for spender.
View returning allowed[_holder][_spender].
onlyOwner; moves _amount from balances into a new LockupInfo round and sets locks[_holder].
onlyOwner; deletes a lockup round, swaps in the last round, and credits balances.
onlyOwner; sets frozen[_holder] = true.
onlyOwner; sets frozen[_holder] = false.
View returning block timestamp (now).
View exposing lockupInfo array data for a holder.
onlyOwner; moves tokens from owner balance to _to.
onlyOwner; calls distribute then lock.
onlyOwner; performs an external transfer of an arbitrary ERC20 token held by this contract.
onlyOwner; burns _value from msg.sender balance and totalSupply_.
onlyOwner; mints _amount to _to and increases totalSupply_.
Internal view using extcodesize to test whether addr is a contract.
Internal; iterates lockupInfo and releases rounds whose releaseTime <= now.
Internal; computes time-based release amount with now and updates balances/lockupInfo.
Caller address; drives ownership, authorization and balance/allowance accounting.
Block timestamp (now) used by autoUnlock, releaseTimeLock and getNowTime for vesting calculations.
External call spender.receiveApproval(msg.sender,_value,this,_extraData) to an attacker-controlled contract.
External call token.transfer(_to,_value) on an owner-supplied token address.
Timestamp-derived arithmetic (sinceFrom, sinceRound, releaseAmount) inside releaseTimeLock.

Parameter _to of transfer.
Parameter _value of transfer.
Parameter _from of transferFrom.
Parameter _holder of lock.
Parameter _amount of lock.
Parameter _idx of unlock.
Parameter _spender of approveAndCall.
Parameter _extraData of approveAndCall, forwarded to receiveApproval.

Loop index idx inside autoUnlock.
Local releaseAmount computed in releaseTimeLock.

edges.reason: Ownable constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, establishing the privileged account.
Constructor directly writes the owner state variable from msg.sender.
onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender with owner before transferOwnership executes.
onlyNewOwner modifier compares msg.sender with newOwner in acceptOwnership.
transfer uses msg.sender as the debited account and notFrozen subject.
transferFrom uses msg.sender as the spender for the allowance check.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][_spender].
burn is onlyOwner and debits balances[msg.sender].
lock is onlyOwner; msg.sender must equal owner.
unlock is onlyOwner; msg.sender must equal owner.
freezeAccount is onlyOwner.
unfreezeAccount is onlyOwner.
distribute is onlyOwner and debits balances[owner].
claimToken is onlyOwner and can move any token held by the contract.
mint is onlyOwner and creates new supply.
releaseTimeLock derives sinceFrom/sinceRound/releaseAmount from now (timestamp dependency).
autoUnlock branches on lockupInfo[_holder][idx].releaseTime <= now.
getNowTime returns now, exposing timestamp dependency.
transferOwnership writes newOwner.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner into owner.
acceptOwnership resets newOwner to 0x0.
pause sets paused = true.
unpause sets paused = false.
BMW constructor sets name.
BMW constructor sets symbol.
BMW constructor sets initialSupply.
BMW constructor computes totalSupply_ = initialSupply * 10 ** decimals.
BMW constructor credits the entire supply to balances[owner].
transfer debits balances[msg.sender] and credits balances[_to].
transfer uses SafeMath.sub for the sender balance.
transfer uses SafeMath.add for the recipient balance.
transfer conditionally invokes autoUnlock when locks[msg.sender] is set.
balanceOf reads balances[_holder].
balanceOf sums lockupBalance values from lockupInfo[_holder].
transferFrom updates both source and destination balances.
transferFrom checks and decrements allowed[_from][msg.sender].
transferFrom uses SafeMath.sub on balances and allowance.
transferFrom uses SafeMath.add for the recipient balance.
transferFrom conditionally invokes autoUnlock when locks[_from] is set.
approve writes the allowed mapping.
approveAndCall calls approve internally.
approveAndCall requires isContract(_spender).
approveAndCall performs an external call to attacker-controlled receiveApproval while allowance state is already set.
increaseAllowance updates the allowed mapping.
decreaseAllowance updates the allowed mapping.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
lock debits balances[_holder] by _amount.
lock pushes a new LockupInfo round into lockupInfo[_holder].
lock sets locks[_holder] = true.
lock uses SafeMath.mul for the per-round unlock amount.
lock uses SafeMath.div(_amount, 100) for the unlock rate.
unlock deletes/swaps elements of lockupInfo[_holder].
unlock clears locks[_holder] when the last round is removed.
unlock credits releaseAmount back to balances[_holder].
unlock uses SafeMath.add to credit the released balance.
freezeAccount sets frozen[_holder] = true.
unfreezeAccount sets frozen[_holder] = false.
showLockState reads lockupInfo[_holder][_idx].
distribute moves balances between owner and _to.
distribute checks and debits balances[owner].
distribute uses SafeMath.sub on balances[owner].
distribute uses SafeMath.add on balances[_to].
distributeWithLockup calls distribute.
distributeWithLockup calls lock on the same amount.
claimToken performs an external token.transfer call.
burn decreases totalSupply_.
burn decreases balances[msg.sender].
burn uses SafeMath.sub on balances and totalSupply_.
mint increases totalSupply_.
mint increases balances[_to].
mint uses SafeMath.add for supply and balance.
autoUnlock calls releaseTimeLock when a round's releaseTime <= now.
autoUnlock iterates and mutates lockupInfo[_holder] through releaseTimeLock.
autoUnlock reads locks[_holder] to decide termination.
releaseTimeLock computes sinceFrom/sinceRound/releaseAmount from block timestamp.
releaseTimeLock credits balances[_holder] with the released amount.
releaseTimeLock clears locks[_holder] when no rounds remain.
releaseTimeLock updates releaseTime and lockupBalance in lockupInfo.
releaseTimeLock uses SafeMath.sub for sinceFrom and lockupBalance.
releaseTimeLock uses SafeMath.add for releaseAmount and balances.
releaseTimeLock uses SafeMath.div for sinceRound.
releaseTimeLock uses SafeMath.mul for sinceRound * unlockAmountPerRound.
The receiveApproval callback can re-enter transfer/transferFrom of this token while approveAndCall is still executing.
Parameter _newOwner flows into transferOwnership state write.
Parameter _to of transfer flows into balances credit.
Parameter _value of transfer flows into balances debit.
Parameter _from of transferFrom flows into balance and allowance checks.
Parameter _holder of lock flows into balances and lockupInfo.
Parameter _amount of lock flows into the LockupInfo round.
Parameter _idx of unlock indexes lockupInfo.
Parameter _spender of approveAndCall is the target of the external call.
Parameter _extraData is forwarded verbatim to receiveApproval.
Parameter _releaseStart becomes LockupInfo.releaseTime.
Parameter _termOfRound becomes LockupInfo.termOfRound.
Parameter _releaseRate scales the per-round unlock amount.
Local idx controls the autoUnlock loop over lockupInfo.
Local releaseAmount accumulates the timestamp-derived payout.
Local sinceRound is derived from block.timestamp and termOfRound.

The parameter only supplies the recipient for transfer's balance update.

The parameter only supplies the source account checked in transferFrom.
The parameter only identifies the account whose balance is escrowed in lock.
The parameter only supplies the escrowed amount for the lock LockupInfo round.
The parameter only indexes the lockupInfo array in unlock.
The parameter only names the external callee that receives receiveApproval.
The parameter is passed straight through to the external receiveApproval call.
The parameter only populates LockupInfo.releaseTime inside lock.
The parameter only populates LockupInfo.termOfRound inside lock.
The parameter only scales the per-round unlock amount computed in lock.
The local loop index exists solely to iterate lockupInfo inside autoUnlock.
The local accumulates the timestamp-derived payout credited in releaseTimeLock.
The local is the timestamp-to-round conversion used by releaseTimeLock.
